The new cabin is expected to occupy the first two rows of each aircraft. Frontier’s

planned configuration uses a 2-by-2 arrangement, replacing the standard 3-by-3 economy layout in those rows. That means eight larger premium seats per plane, displacing roughly 12 economy seats. The product is expected to emphasize added space and comfort, rather than lie-flat seats or an elaborate onboard dining service.
